record.population: Black hairstyling practices and traction alopecia
record.finding: The review stratifies hair care and styling practices into high-, moderate- and low-risk categories for traction alopecia, with a diagnostic approach and conservative management guidance.
record.note: Abstract only: which style falls in which category was not read. Risk is by tension and practice, not by curl type.
